## Upgrade from 0.4.0

0.5.0 adds no schema migrations. SQL stores stay at `V008`, and MongoDB needs no new
initialization. Jakarta EE and Quarkus deployments can upgrade by deploying matching API,
engine, and store artifacts.

Custom stores need no new contract methods.

## Spring Boot starters

- New `ratchet-spring-boot-starter` (SQL) and `ratchet-spring-boot-starter-mongodb`, managed
  by `ratchet-bom`. They support Spring Boot 3.5 and 4.1 on Java 17 or later and were tested
  against Boot 3.5.16 and 4.1.1.
- The SQL starter uses the application's datasource, entity-manager factory, and transaction
  manager. It adds Ratchet's entity mappings without replacing application entities,
  converters, or JPA properties. It works with the MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server
  stores.
- The MongoDB starter uses Boot's configured Mongo client and database factory.
- Job targets resolve as Spring beans, and `@Recurring` methods are discovered from bean
  metadata. Jobs submitted inside a Spring transaction are scheduled after commit. Shutdown
  drains running work within a bounded time.
- Schema migration is on by default in Spring Boot. Set `ratchet.schema.auto-migrate=false`
  to validate an externally managed SQL or MongoDB schema at startup without writing to it.
- `spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true` enables the virtual execution pool on Java 21 and
  later.
- Spring AOT processing and GraalVM native executables are supported.

Your application's Boot BOM chooses the Spring and Hibernate versions. Ratchet does not
override it, so choose a Boot version with the security fixes you need. See the
[Spring Boot guide](https://github.com/ratchet-run/ratchet/blob/v0.5.0/website/docs/deployment/spring-boot.md)
for setup, transactions, and schema ownership.

## Fixes for all runtimes

- A transient failure while recording completion no longer loses a job that succeeded.
- Batch finalization now runs outside the completed job's transaction.
- Lifecycle hooks stay paired when startup fails.
- Startup warns again when the retired `ratchet.worker.use-virtual-threads` setting is present.
- Netty and Vert.x are updated for security fixes, and Quarkus native builds still work.
